evidence: Spelling: extracted the full lowercase word inventory (640 distinct tokens) of instruction.md + hireops_rules.md + integration.md and read every token; no misspellings found (names such as halvorsen, sorensen, okafor match seed users). Only variant: instruction.md uses British 'honour PORT' / 'honouring DB_PATH' (instruction.md:13) while hireops_rules.md:201 says 'Honor the supplied DB_PATH' and integration.md:8 'honoring' - both are valid spellings, consistent within each file, not a real spelling error. Contamination: grep for TODO|FIXME|XXX|CHANGE_ME|placeholder|TBD|lorem|C:\\|/Users/|/home/|F:/|turing|claude|judge|rubric|criteri|score|playwright|glm|/tests|sentinel|probe over all three brief files returned no hits; template CHANGE_ME lines (template instruction.md:1, notes.md:1) are fully replaced and notes.md is not shipped. Files are UTF-8 without BOM, LF, all-ASCII, no trailing whitespace. No author asides, no duplicated paragraphs (integration.md = template text plus one added /app delivery paragraph; hireops_rules.md section 8 overlaps it in topic but adds distinct facts: non-/app cwd, unprivileged user, launch env list). Contradiction cross-check: one seed path (/assets/seed_data.json in instruction.md:13, hireops_rules.md:206, integration.md:7); one password Hireops!2026 (instruction.md:17, hireops_rules.md:11); account list in instruction.md:17 matches the 10 seed users and roles exactly (3 recruiter, 3 hiring_manager, 1 observer, 3 candidate); port 3000/PORT, /app/app.db/DB_PATH, health-without-DB, Node+Express+SQLite, CDN allowed but no external data service all agree across the three files; 15 seconds (instruction.md:5 'fifteen', rules:117 '15'); undo 'as long as nobody has touched those cards since' (instruction.md:3) is refined, not contradicted, by rules:96-100; candidate wording table (rules:183-190) equals seed candidate_status_labels; page size 30 (rules:144) equals seed thread_page_size; Activity example names Mei Lin and Priya Nair exist in seed; no clock value is stated anywhere, so no clock conflict. Weak/alternative-app probe: a builder reading rules:21 '401 for no session' literally could auth-gate GET /api/health, but instruction.md:13 and integration.md:9-10 make health a pre-database check, and the obvious reading (data endpoints) is consistent - not a contradiction. Cosmetic only: hireops_rules.md has edit-splice line wrapping (line 90 ends early at 'rules above,'; lines 99, 112, 173 run long) which markdown reflows and readers do not see as contamination. Row is source-only; no runtime measurement is required, so the absence of judge/Oracle runs is not a gap for this row.
